name: 2 tc fort build feudal into raider elephants etc season 12
author: PeNDraGoN

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ , build 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ instantly and use them to scout for sheep left and right

@resource/rally.webp@2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to  @resource/resource_gold.webp@ build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 1st civ (make sure this is a good place for fort later, you surround the fort with farms and houses  then change @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Bring @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ back to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for 50 ish seconds

On 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@  move 2  @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.webp@  and 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@  to @resource/resource_stone.webp@and also move the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@
move other @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ line and drop of its @resource/sheep.webp@

on age up use 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   from  @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   @resource/rally.webp@from  @building_economy/town-center.webp@to age up with @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ 2nd @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (TOTAL OF 5)

rally @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ till 8  move 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@  from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ ( you want 4 on food)

when age up is complete take 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@   and move to @resource/sheep.webp@  then take 1 other @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and move to build @building_economy/house.webp@  at 1st @building_economy/house.webp@ rally 2nd house @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build  @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ with @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@(step below)

take 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near @building_economy/house.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ total of 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ building it

at around 7 mins to 7-30 build @building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@  depending on whats best, @building_military/barracks.webp@ into  @building_military/stable.webp@    vs @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ civs
